targets.authors: Elfenbein DW, Hamilton BH, Zenger RZ
targets.title: The small firm effect and the entrepreneurial spawning of scientists and engineers.
targets.evidence_quote: We begin by replicating prior results regarding firm size and the likelihood of becoming an entrepreneur (e.g., Elfenbein et al. 2010, Gompers et al. 2005, Kacperczyk 2012, Sørensen 2007).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, we are able to replicate the commonly found “small-firm effect,” but when we restrict our analyses to observe workers in dissolved firms alone, we no longer find the negative effect.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors confirm the cited small-firm result in the ordinary sample and explicitly report its disappearance and reversal among defunct firms. Their aggregate statement distinguishes these outcomes.
